"""
    n_partitions = cluster_runs.shape[0]
    n_samples = cluster_runs.shape[1]
    hypergraph_adjacency = sparse.lil_matrix((n_partitions, n_partitions))

    for i in range(n_partitions):
        for j in range(n_partitions):
            if i != j:
                hypergraph_adjacency[i, j] = np.sum(cluster_runs[i] == cluster_runs[j])

    hypergraph_adjacency = hypergraph_adjacency.tocsr()
    return hypergraph_adjacency


def build_hypergraph_laplacian(cluster_runs):
    """Return the laplacian of a hypergraph, in sparse matrix representation.
    
    Parameters
    ----------
    cluster_runs : array of shape (n_partitions, n_samples)
    
    Returns
    -------
    hypergraph_laplacian : compressed sparse row matrix
        Represents the laplacian of the hypergraph associated with an ensemble
        of partitions, each partition corresponding to a row of the array
        'cluster_runs' provided at input.
    """
    n_partitions = cluster_runs.shape[0]
    n_samples = cluster_runs.shape[1]

    hypergraph_adjacency = build_hypergraph_adjacency(cluster_runs)

    hypergraph_laplacian = sparse.eye(n_partitions, dtype=float) - hypergraph_adjacency

    return hypergraph_laplacian
